SETTINGS.TITLE: Messenger templates
SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Save reusable Messenger scripts with dynamic variables. Load them in the simulator or export them from a conversation with the real contact details.
SETTINGS.LOAD_ERROR: We could not load your templates. Check your connection and try again.

EMPTY.TITLE: No templates yet
EMPTY.DESCRIPTION: A template stores a fictional Messenger script. Add variables such as the contact name or a custom attribute and they are filled in when you export from a conversation.

NO_RESULTS.DESCRIPTION: No template matches “{query}”. Try a different title.

DELETE_CONFIRM.MESSAGE: Removed for everyone in this account.

SETTINGS.DELETE_ERROR: We could not delete the template. Try again.
SETTINGS.DUPLICATE_ERROR: We could not duplicate the template. Try again.

DEFAULT.RESTORE_HINT: Replaces the title and the messages of the default template.
DEFAULT.RESTORE_ERROR: We could not restore the default template. Try again.

EDITOR.DESCRIPTION: Write the script once. Variables are replaced with real data when you export the template from a conversation.
EDITOR.NOT_FOUND: This template no longer exists. It may have been deleted.

NAME.LABEL: Template title
NAME.REQUIRED: Add a title so you can find this template later.

EDITOR.INVALID: Check the warnings in the editor before saving.
EDITOR.COPY_SUCCESS: Copy saved as a new template.
EDITOR.SAVE_ERROR: We could not save the template. Check your connection and try again.

UNSAVED.TITLE: Leave without saving?
UNSAVED.MESSAGE: You have unsaved changes in this template. They will be lost.

VARIABLES.LOAD_ERROR: We could not load the available variables. Try again.
VARIABLES.UNKNOWN: {token} is not an available variable. Pick one from the list.

MANUAL.HINT: You type its value when you export the template from a conversation.
MANUAL.INVALID: Use letters or numbers so we can build a name for this variable.

SIMULATOR.ERROR: We could not load your templates. Your draft is unchanged; try again.
SIMULATOR.DRAFT_AVAILABLE: We kept the draft you were working on in this account.
SIMULATOR.DRAFT_RESTORED: We restored the draft you had open.

CONVERSATION_EXPORT.EMPTY: No templates saved yet. Create one in Settings.
CONVERSATION_EXPORT.ERROR: We could not export this template. Check your connection and try again.
CONVERSATION_EXPORT.CONTACT_CHANGED: The contact details changed while the screenshot was being prepared. Reopen the menu and try again.

MANUAL_MODAL.TITLE: Fill in the manual variables
MANUAL_MODAL.DESCRIPTION: These values are not stored anywhere: they go straight into this screenshot.

AI.TITLE: Create with LuxoIA
AI.DESCRIPTION: Upload a screenshot of a Messenger conversation. LuxoIA extracts the texts and suggests variables.
AI.HINT: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
AI.TOO_LARGE: The image is over 5 MB. Try a smaller screenshot.
AI.WRONG_TYPE: Upload a PNG, JPG or WebP image.
AI.SUCCESS: We loaded the conversation from the screenshot.
AI.NOT_CONFIGURED: LuxoIA is not set up yet. Add your OpenAI key to use it.
AI.FAILED: LuxoIA could not read the screenshot. Try a sharper image.

SUGGESTIONS.TITLE: Suggested variables
SUGGESTIONS.DESCRIPTION: Pick the values that change from one conversation to the next. We replace every occurrence in the script.
SUGGESTIONS.EMPTY: LuxoIA found no value worth turning into a variable.
